body:
# 💎 Ruby Item Mod

This is a small, simple Fabric mod that adds a new item: **Ruby**.  
The ruby appears in the **Ingredients** tab of the Creative Inventory and can be used as a base item for future crafting ideas or modpacks.

---

## ✨ Features
- Adds a new Ruby item
- Fully registered in the Ingredients creative tab
- Lightweight and easy to add to any modpack
- Great as a starting point for learning Fabric modding

---

## 🧪 How to Use
- Install Fabric Loader
- Install the correct Fabric API version
- Launch the game and find the Ruby in the **Ingredients** section in Creative Mode

---

## 🐛 Issues / Bugs
If something doesn’t work or you want to suggest improvements, please open an issue here:  
**https://github.com/bendavagmo-collab/fabric-tutorial-1.20.2/issues**

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility
- **Minecraft:** 1.20.2  
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric  
- Works in **singleplayer** and **multiplayer** (server + client)
